other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a licensed Gad-Hanji (Fisherman) for the last three consecutive years.
Applicant must not have received assistance under this scheme in the last two years.
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Jammu & Kashmir.
benefits_summary: Provides a one-time financial assistance for Nylon Twine purchase ranging from ₹200 to ₹500 depending on licence fee paid.
